thread:
Anya: Heads-up — we've got a customer hitting duplicated events when reconnecting via SSE. Suspect partial chunking + client ack loss.
Jordan: Repro steps?
Anya: Start with a long stream, then send a proxy pause that returns 204 with chunked transfer-encoding. Client sees a truncated last event and reopens. Some clients replay from last-event-id and get duplicates.
Samir: Is this the resume token path or pure last-event-id? any logs?
Anya: last-event-id. I attached snippets in prod: proxy was returning `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` then closed without a final zero-length chunk; browser clients treat last chunk as complete, some mobile libs don't, they retry. ops-bot showed increase in /events POSTs during that window.
Lee: Oof. So telemetry-wise we need to differentiate `partial_chunk_close` vs normal close. Console currently only surfaces socket-close counts.
console-team: Agreed — current dashboard only shows event_open/event_close; add a `partial_chunk_detected` counter + link to request id. We can sample 1% to avoid cardinality spam.
Jordan: On routing/policy: when this happens, clients often hit a different edge region and billing counts as new session. Should we add sticky routing for reconnects within 10s to avoid double-charge? Might help.
Samir: Sticky helps but doesn't fix parser semantics. Short-term: implement server-side idempotency via resume-token namespace. If the client supplies last-event-id, we treat resumed stream as de-duplicated for 30s.
Anya: Plan: 1) quick console metric (partial_chunk_detected/partial_chunk_sample) rollout behind flag (canary 5%); 2) server resume de-dupe for last-event-id for 30s; 3) sticky routing heuristic as optional flag for affected customers; 4) add docs note for clients and example JS snippet.
Jordan: For the JS snippet, propose adding this to docs: ```js
// when reconnecting, prefer resume-token header
fetch('/events', {headers: {'x-resume-token': token}})
``` 
Lee: I'll own dashboard PR. console-team will add sampling and traces. Samir/Jordan can own runtime patch. Anya do you want to own rollout plan and customer comms?
Anya: Yes I'll draft comms. Timing: patch + canary metrics tomorrow, runtime rollback-safe flag, full rollout after 48h of stable canary metrics.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-12 — assign to Samir, Jordan, Lee, Anya.
Anya: assigning tasks + linking PRs in thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
